raw_scene_note: Creator asked to jam on a new idea without supplying a literal lived incident, so this run uses a fresh concept tournament rather than a raw-scene lock.

success_definition.audience_success: A cold viewer tags or sends this to the person who has stood beside their last-minute getting-ready chaos.
success_definition.creative_success: The carousel works as a backstage scene sequence before any text: action, hands, eye-line, object movement, consequence, reversal, and payoff.
success_definition.brand_success: A warm desi relationship receipt where small outfit panic becomes affectionate shared choreography, not generic couple sweetness.
success_definition.production_success: If approved later, separate native 4:5 and native 9:16 finals, identity references, visual QA, and final audit are required.
